physics.work_semantics: actual dispatched evaluations and derivative batches, including speculative threads; optimizer ledger separately retains SPD reservation/charge semantics
physics.localization_model: exact homogeneous disk Mie series, qualified by selected backend
physics.discretization: Fourier-Galerkin traces |m|<=K_trace; Chebyshev radial and log|W|^2 expansions on window K_trace+margin; Graf sources/receivers; no boundary collocation
physics.certificate_arithmetic: exact-arithmetic residual inequality with heuristic FFT allowance; not interval verified
physics.execution_note: Execution.device selects geometry preparation and assembly (modal_cuda on CUDA); scalar kernels, Graf waves, LU, fields and Jacobian on the CPU; Execution.acceleration selects only the Mie grid; Execution.resolution is not used
physics.retained_state: up to 4 prepared geometries per device (device arrays for CUDA); LU factors on the host in handles

geometry_settings.name: centred_state_band_spectral_projection
geometry_settings.coordinates: real Fourier coefficients of normal distance h (m) in normalized arclength
geometry_settings.construction: z + P_K[R(z+h*n)-R(z)], R = eq. 9 arclength quadrature (no splines); FD derivative of the complete trial
geometry_settings.resampler: eq. 9 quadrature on the uniform grid (count and 2*count); no splines
geometry_settings.projection_error_control: coarse/fine diagnostic; not a rigorous bound
geometry_settings.validity: exact area -> Lemma 3-4 increment vs accepted-curve Y -> full |W|^2 certificate (crop + Lemma 3 tail) -> sampled test (unchanged fallback)
geometry_settings.regularity: coefficient residual lower bound >= 1e-12 sum j^2|x_j|^2
geometry_settings.certificate_arithmetic: float64 with heuristic FFT rounding allowance; not interval verified
